title: atopile layout_ir
description: The stable text<->geometry interface (BACKLOG §B/§C3). Net names drift and uuids are random under v10, so the text layer references only ato addresses; the IR translates. Pinned by test_layout_ir_contract.py + test_room_migration_contract.py. v2: rooms (derived from footprint sheetname) replaced groups. The optional `signal_nets` (bridge ②, I4b) is folded in only by graph-aware callers.

layout_ir_version.description: Schema version; consumers must gate on it.

components.description: Managed footprints keyed by ato address (== the pcb atopile_address property, I1).

nets.description: Geometry net name -> sorted ["<addr>.<pad>"] endpoints. The empty net is never a key (I4a).

rooms.description: Rooms keyed by name (= footprint sheetname, BACKLOG §C3). Derived, no object identity.

signal_nets.description: Bridge ② (I4b): signal ato-address -> kicad net name. Graph-derived, optional; absent for pcb-only callers.

xyr.description: [x, y, rotation_degrees]; rotation defaults to 0.0 when absent in the pcb.

net.description: Geometry-bound net name (I3); "" means no net.
